QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_42

question.text: A Cat III AIF's stewardship policy must address (per Principle 3 of the Stewardship Code):

answer.text: Continuous monitoring of investee companies, including areas, extent, and insider-trading boundaries
Only investee company financial statement audit
Disclosure of fund manager's personal trades

explanation.text: The Logic: Principle 3 of the AIF Stewardship Code (SEBI Master Circular 31-July-2023): AIFs should monitor their investee companies CONTINUOUSLY via a policy that addresses areas and extent of monitoring including situations that do not require monitoring. The policy must also respect insider-trading regulations when seeking information. The Trap: Options B, C, D are narrow or irrelevant to Principle 3. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the Stewardship Code across categories. III-A/C (Compliance) references insider-trading framework. Manager's Pro-Tip: The insider-trading hook is critical: when a Cat III fund receives UPSI while monitoring a listed investee, trading on that investee's stock must stop. Build a Chinese wall between stewardship and PM teams.
